title: ComfyUI Server Routes official documentation
use_for: Local server route list; /prompt validation and queue behavior; /history, /queue, /view, /upload/image, /system_stats, /object_info.
notes: The routes page states that the web client submits to /prompt, which validates the prompt, queues it, and returns prompt_id/number or errors.

title: ComfyUI Workflow JSON schema official specification
use_for: Distinguishing UI workflow JSON schema from API prompt format and preserving workflow graph semantics.
notes: The official spec defines workflow JSON using JSON Schema; this is the UI workflow serialization family, not the only API payload form.

title: ComfyUI basic_api_example.py official script example
use_for: Minimal local Python API example: API prompt format, node IDs as keys, class_type, inputs, editing prompt and seed, POST to 127.0.0.1:8188/prompt.
notes: The example comments say API format can be exported from the interface with File -> Export (API).

title: ComfyUI Cloud API Overview official documentation
use_for: Cloud API concepts: workflows are API-format JSON objects; jobs are asynchronous; submit, monitor via WebSocket or poll, retrieve outputs.
notes: Cloud endpoint path differs from local endpoint, but the async workflow pattern is useful for product architecture.

title: Gradio Blocks official documentation
use_for: Blocks layout, queue enabling, queue max size, default concurrency limits, and web app construction around long-running inference calls.
notes: Blocks.queue controls user queue visibility, queue size, and concurrency defaults.

title: Gradio Queuing guide official documentation
use_for: Concurrent event handling, per-event queues, concurrency_limit, and shared concurrency_id for resource-limited GPU tasks.
notes: Useful for preventing a Gradio UI from overdriving one ComfyUI backend.

title: Gradio State in Blocks official guide
use_for: Global, session, and browser state in Gradio apps; preserving session-specific ComfyUI job IDs and UI state.
notes: The guide distinguishes global state shared between users from per-session and browser-local state.

title: Gradio File component official documentation
use_for: File upload event listeners and file input handling for Gradio-to-ComfyUI bridges.
notes: File.upload, File.change, clear, delete, download events are documented for file lifecycle handling.
